title: Formononetin attenuates hepatic injury in diabetic mice by regulating macrophage polarization through the PTP1B/STAT6 axis.
authors: Wang, Jinchun; Wang, Lei; Han, Lei; Han, Yiwen; Gu, Jun; Chen, Zhujing
one_liner_zh: 该文研究药物Formononetin通过PTP1B/STAT6轴调节巨噬细胞极化改善糖尿病肝损伤，核心为蛋白-蛋白互作与药物结合，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA体系，且无AI/物理模拟方法。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Formononetin (FNT) is an isoflavone known for its anti-inflammatory properties and has been shown to reduce insulin resistance in Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus (T2DM). However, its effects and the underlying mechanisms in diabetic liver injury remain largely unexplored. METHODS: We established a T2DM-induced liver injury mouse model by feeding high-fat diet, followed by injecting streptozotocin. The mice were then treated with FNT and the liver function in these mice was assessed. Macrophage markers in FNT-treated T2DM mice or human THP-1 cells were evaluated using flow cytometry, RT-qPCR, and Western blotting. The expression of PTP1B and STAT6 in mouse liver tissues and THP-1 cells was analyzed. Molecular docking predicted the interaction between PTP1B and STAT6, which was validated via co-immunoprecipitation (Co-IP) and phos-tag analysis. Microscale thermophoresis (MST) assessed the binding affinity of FNT to PTP1B. RESULTS: FNT treatment significantly ameliorated blood glucose levels, hepatocyte apoptosis, inflammatory response, and liver dysfunction in T2DM mice. Moreover, FNT facilitated M2 macrophage polarization in both T2DM mice and high glucose (HG)-induced THP-1-derived macrophages. The PTP1B/STAT6 axis, deregulated in T2DM mice, was normalized by FNT treatment, which counteracted the T2DM-induced upregulation of PTP1B and downregulation of phosphorylated STAT6. Molecular docking and subsequent analyses revealed that PTP1B binds to and dephosphorylates STAT6 at the S325A site. In contrast, FNT strongly binds to PTP1B and influences its expression at the K116A site, promoting M2 polarization of THP-1 cells via downregulation of PTP1B. CONCLUSION: Formononetin mitigates diabetic hepatic injury by fostering M2 macrophage polarization via the PTP1B/STAT6 axis.
abstract_zh: 背景：芒柄花素（Formononetin, FNT）是一种具有抗炎特性的异黄酮，并已被证明可降低2型糖尿病（Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus, T2DM）中的胰岛素抵抗。然而，其在糖尿病肝损伤中的作用及潜在机制仍 largely 未被探索。方法：我们通过高脂饮食喂养并随后注射链脲佐菌素，建立了T2DM诱导的肝损伤小鼠模型。随后用FNT处理小鼠，并评估其肝功能。通过流式细胞术、RT-qPCR和Western blotting评估FNT处理的T2DM小鼠或人THP-1细胞中的巨噬细胞标志物。分析了小鼠肝组织和THP-1细胞中PTP1B和STAT6的表达。分子对接预测了PTP1B与STAT6之间的相互作用，并通过免疫共沉淀（co-immunoprecipitation, Co-IP）和phos-tag分析进行了验证。微量热泳动（Microscale thermophoresis, MST）评估了FNT与PTP1B的结合亲和力。结果：FNT处理显著改善了T2DM小鼠的血糖水平、肝细胞凋亡、炎症反应和肝功能障碍。此外，FNT促进了T2DM小鼠和高糖（high glucose, HG）诱导的THP-1来源巨噬细胞中的M2巨噬细胞极化。在T2DM小鼠中失调的PTP1B/STAT6轴，经FNT处理后恢复正常，抵消了T2DM诱导的PTP1B上调和磷酸化STAT6下调。分子对接及后续分析揭示，PTP1B结合STAT6并在S325A位点去磷酸化。相反，FNT强效结合PTP1B并影响其在K116A位点的表达，通过下调PTP1B促进THP-1细胞的M2极化。结论：芒柄花素通过PTP1B/STAT6轴促进M2巨噬细胞极化，从而减轻糖尿病性肝损伤。
